task.description: The address of the task to scope, for example @v1/nuucognition/task.dev/<id>#ops. Give it at the open for a task that exists. Else Stage 3 creates the task: then set it with flint shard invocations set-input <id> task=<address>.

steps.title: Research
steps.next: Research before you write: the task in Ops when it exists, the Mesh, the code, and the related Ops tasks. Write nothing yet.

steps.title: Draft Proposal
steps.next: Write the proposal in paragraphs (background, approach, alternatives, open questions, references), and the scope with the definition of done.

steps.title: Scope Writing
steps.next: Write the scope into the task note of the task, or create the task with flint shard task task-new and a body file, and place it. When you create it, set the input to the field ops of the output: flint shard invocations set-input {{invocation}} task=<address>.

next.interactive: Walk the person through the proposal of {{task}}, and write each change into the task note until the person confirms.
next.headless: Check the scope of {{task}} yourself. Keep each open question under Notes with your recommendation.

next.interactive: Resolve or defer each open question. For a task.dev, set the stage: ops task stage {{task}} scoped. Run flint shard task task-sync {{task}}. Then close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done.
next.headless: Resolve or defer each open question. For a task.dev, set the stage: ops task stage {{task}} scoped. Run flint shard task task-sync {{task}}. Close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done. Put the do_task command in the result. When no parent frame is open, return with flint orbh session return --finish. When the close prints back in: (a parent frame is open), do not return: continue the parent frame.

behaviours.say: The input task is empty: no task is recorded. Set it with flint shard invocations set-input {{invocation}} task=<address>, or close the invocation with --outcome abandoned.
